environment: STAGING existing isolated PostgreSQL; restricted runtime; native MCP route dispatch; email disabled
scope: Native MCP bridge and paginated business data runtime. OAuth transport, browser and production are separate checks.

cases.name: MCP capability catalog exposes strict per-line percentage sale, confirmation, PDF, finance and Admin operations
Native MCP route saves and reloads a draft with independent decimal percentages and rejects cash/price overrides
Native MCP confirmation creates one stock/finance linkage and confirmed read returns exact totals
MCP downloads the actual immutable customer PDF in bounded chunks
MCP data catalog exposes new business provenance with pagination while credentials stay excluded
MCP accountant payment writes canonical partial money and live reconciliation reports the same paid amount
MCP Admin can edit the canonical sale by percentage, recall it and retain the original PDF and actual payment history
